title: NPD OCP Infra / Node Overview
description: Select a node to see CPU, memory, disk, network. Cluster variable is informational (Grafana already talks to this cluster's Thanos). Units: disk = MiB/s (IEC), network = bits/s (Mbps).

panels.title: Status — answer: CPU, memory, disk, or network?
CPU I/O Wait %
panels.description: Time cores wait for block I/O. Correlate with Disk dashboard.

panels.title: Worst filesystem %
panels.description: Max used% across real filesystems (tmpfs/overlay excluded).

panels.title: Load 1
panels.description: 1-minute load average. Compare with CPU count.

panels.title: Network RX
panels.description: Sum of physical/uplink RX. Unit: bits/s (Mbps).

panels.title: Network TX
panels.description: Sum of physical/uplink TX. Unit: bits/s (Mbps).

panels.title: Disk read
panels.description: Sum of block-device read throughput. Unit: MiB/s (IEC).

panels.title: Disk write
panels.description: Sum of block-device write throughput. Unit: MiB/s (IEC).

panels.title: CPU I/O Wait %
panels.description: High iowait + high disk latency = storage bottleneck, not CPU starve.

panels.title: Disk (all devices of selected node) — pick a device on Disk dashboard
Disk throughput
panels.description: IEC bytes/s (MiB/s). Filter one device on Disk / Storage dashboard.

panels.title: Disk latency (avg per I/O)
panels.description: Average service time. clamp_min avoids divide-by-zero when IOPS=0.

panels.title: Disk busy % (iostat util)
panels.description: Fraction of time the device had I/O in flight. Can exceed 100% on some RAID.

panels.title: Filesystem used %
panels.description: Excludes tmpfs, overlay, squashfs, nsfs, iso9660, autofs, devtmpfs, proc, sysfs.

panels.title: Network RX / TX (physical + br-ex)
panels.description: Bits/s. veth/OVN internals excluded — see docs/promql.md.
